read.thesis: Magna guides 2026 adjusted EBIT margin 6.0%-6.6% and FCF $1.6-1.8bn on operational excellence (35-40bp), with no pricing benefit assumed and capex held below 4% of sales.

capex.quote: With CapEx below 4% of sales, we expect 2026 to be another year of strong free cash flow

triggers.label: BEV capex cycle behind us
triggers.quote: The significant investments in BEV in terms of capital sites or EVs for our product line is behind us.

triggers.label: 2026 EBIT margin 6.0-6.6%
triggers.quote: Our outlook is for adjusted EBIT margins to be in the range of 6% to 6.6%, which implies margin expansion of between 40 and 100 basis points from 2025.

triggers.label: Recall and warranty cost uncertainty
triggers.quote: Whether that could be more or less than what we have estimated, we will see.

triggers.label: No pricing benefit in organic growth
triggers.quote: It would be primarily volume. Launching new programs. Higher content.

guidance.quote: Our outlook is for adjusted EBIT margins to be in the range of 6% to 6.6%
Our outlook range for sales in 2026 implies that sales will be near flat to up 3.5% versus last year.
For 2026, we are planning for adjusted EPS in the range of $6.25 to $7.25 per share.
free cash flow, in the range of $1,600,000,000 to $1,800,000,000, or over 90% of adjusted net income
With CapEx below 4% of sales, we expect 2026 to be another year of strong free cash flow

guidance.value: approx. 22 million shares, full NCIB remainder
guidance.quote: we plan to repurchase all remaining shares during 2026
is expected to add an additional 35 to 40 basis points of margin benefit in 2026

red_flags.label: Recall and warranty settlements in P&V
red_flags.quote: we did take expense in P&V in the quarter for that settlement.

red_flags.label: Q4 margin flattered by warranty reversal
red_flags.quote: Seating margins benefited from the reversal of a warranty accrual in the current period

red_flags.label: DRAM cost pressure unresolved
red_flags.quote: there is a little bit of wait and watch on that DRAM topic

red_flags.label: Engineering revenue weaker
red_flags.quote: engineering has been a little bit weaker. But we do not have visibility in engineering

evasions.quote: relatively neutral year over year. You are correct.

evasions.topic: Free cash flow sustainability with capex step-up
evasions.quote: We believe that level of free cash flow is sustainable.
